name: Serpent's Coil
summary: Dark cultists shelter in Serpent's Coil, among caves and burnt encampments in the eastern Blasted Lands. Scorched orcish ruins from older wars line the ridges.

sections.title: A Labyrinth of Ash and Stone
sections.body: In the eastern Blasted Lands, Serpent's Coil winds through cliffs and old ruins. Its paths pass ruined orcish huts from the First and Second Wars. Shadowsworn cultists and practitioners of dark arts haunt the tunnels. Demonic energies lingering in the red wastes draw them there, beyond the watchful eyes of Nethergarde Keep.

sections.title: The Cultist Lair
sections.body: Archmage Allistarj's cultists have long used Serpent's Coil as a staging ground. They revere demonic lords and experiment with sinister artifacts such as the Amulet of Allistarj. Though their master's grasp weakens, loyal Shadowsworn zealots still patrol the cave turns. Behind scorched barricades, they keep rituals for Kirith the Damned.

faq.answer: Serpent's Coil winds through caves and a canyon in the eastern Blasted Lands, amid charred orcish ruins.

faq.q: Why are there old orc structures here?
faq.answer: The old encampments date to the First and Second Wars. The Old Horde crossed the nearby Dark Portal then and fortified the surrounding region before its defeat.
Shadowsworn cultists aligned with Archmage Allistarj occupy the caverns and serve demonic powers.

angles.text: As a Warlock, you may recognize the Shadowsworn's binding rituals and potent artifacts as grim signs of reckless demonic study.
